title: ever INDY|Double V-neck Satin Maxi Formal Dress with Pockets
descriptionHtml:
Feel radiant in this timeless satin maxi dress that flatters every formal occassion. The ruched bodice flows into an empire waist, creating a stunning silhouette that photographs beautifully. The sleeveless design is perfect for summer weddings, while the premium satin fabric ensures comfort from ceremony to last dance. Available in a range of colors to match any styles.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
